claim.value: Uncertainty in matching records should be preserved explicitly.
claim.scope: Uncertain matches encountered while assembling booking-level timelines.

provenance.rationale: P008 directly supplies the requirement; P006 identifies the timeline-assembly context.

signal_basis.value: Record matching involves uncertainty, and reconciliation of timestamps, definitions and equipment identities must avoid forcing agreement.
signal_basis.scope: Matching and reconciling records for booking-level timelines.

provenance.rationale: P008 identifies uncertain matches, P012 supplies the reconciliation constraint, and P006 establishes the records and task involved.
The claim is licensed without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: An uncertain match cannot establish that records concern the same event. Preserving that uncertainty maintains the evidential limits of the assembled timeline and is warranted without establishing any cause of lateness.
uncertainty: The correct matches may remain unresolved; this does not undermine the requirement to preserve their uncertainty.
